name: pdf-inspector
tagline: Fast Rust library for PDF inspection, classification, and text extraction
description: pdf-inspector is a fast Rust library for PDF inspection, classification, and text extraction. It intelligently detects whether a PDF is scanned or text-based, enabling smart routing decisions — send scanned PDFs to OCR, pass text PDFs straight to extraction. It ships with Python and Node.js bindings, making it a practical building block for document pipelines and RAG systems.
highlights: Classifies scanned vs text-based PDFs for smart OCR routing
Rust core with Python and Node.js bindings
Purpose-built for RAG and LLM ingestion pipelines
curatorNote: The perfect companion to anydoc: one library tells you what kind of PDF you have, the other turns it into Markdown. Together they are the cleanest open pipeline for document ingestion.
